question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting now, or wait for broader Gateway principal/authorship work?
rationale: Current origin metadata is not enough for billing-grade per-user views, and exposing per-user cost/activity data crosses identity and authorization boundaries.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

options.title: Wait For Principal Design
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics settle.

options.title: External Reporting Only For Now
options.body: Document current usage exports and plugin diagnostics as the supported path for custom spend dashboards until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider usage, Gateway usage RPCs, Dashboard reporting, and the documented security model, where this owner has the strongest recent history.
